_comment: Regression baseline for the PET/PC tutorial chain (openlca_ipc >= 0.4.1, ecoinvent 3.10 Cutoff, EF 3.1 Method (adapted)). These are OUR verified post-fix numbers from case1-report.md / case1_repeatability.ipynb -- NOT the tutorial PDF's numbers, which differ by a known ~0.78x background-dataset factor documented in case1-findings.md ('Residual ~0.78x'). This file guards against future library/MCP regressions changing OUR results, independent of that external residual.
